content: सैरन्ध्री, सैरिन्ध्री .²1 A maid-servant or female attendant in the womenʼs apartments [a woman of the mixed tribe described in सैरन्ध्र (2)]. .²2 An independent female artisan working in another personʼs house. .²3 An epithet of Draupadī (assumed by her when she acted as servant to Sudeṣṇā, queen of Virāṭa).
